name: triage-router

fragments.text:
Pick the lane that fits best:
- order: new orders, reorders, pallet or crate pricing, delivery slots and scheduling.
- refund: credit notes or refunds for a shipment that arrived in bad shape.
- quality: complaints about the fruit itself — overripe on arrival, a broken cold chain, or the wrong ripeness grade — plus ripening-room questions.
- escalation: anything that needs the sales director. Route here if the contact raises a food-safety problem such as mold, pests, contamination, or a cold-chain break; if a big account (roughly $50k+ a year in orders) sounds ready to walk; if they bring up lawyers, a regulator, the press, or a health authority; or if they say they have already reached out several times (about three or more) and still have no fix. When unsure between a lane and escalation on an important account, prefer escalation.
